messages:
sara: kicking off traffic shadowing for model-rt-3 -> shadow pool in eu-west-1, 10% mirror traffic starting now
 mike: seeing GPU pool at ~75% already (12/16 GPUs used). watching autoscaler.
 raj: autoscaler didn't add nodes — CNI logs show allocatable IP exhaustion in eu-west-1a. suspect subnet size drift.
 linh: confirmed — terraform state shows nodepool subnet /28 but current plan expects /26. PR #542 reverted the subnet bump last month.
 deploy-bot: helm upgrade --install model-rt-3-shadow --values values.shadow.yaml returned post-install hook failed: CrashLoopBackOff
 mike: I'm pausing new mirrored sessions from the edge LB (manual remove rule). Sara: ack.
 sara: can we route shadow traffic to another AZ or region temporarily? don't want divergence in evals but need to avoid cascading OOMs.
 andrew: us-west-2 has spare GPUs but cross-region shadowing will skew latency and trace attribution. prefer fix in eu if short.
 raj: short fix: increase nodepool replica from 4 -> 6, but that still needs subnet CIDR bump; I'll open an infra-terraform patch to expand allocation.
 linh: pushing a hotfix branch that flips the gitops helm value for shadow replicas to 2 -> 0 while we stabilize (so release stays installed but no pods). PR: github.com/redwood/ops/merge/298
 deploy-bot: gitops-reconciler queued, waiting on terraform apply to reconcile nodepool resource.
 mike: created alert INFRA:gpu-shadow-surge (threshold 70% sustained 5m) — will add autoscaler failure alert too.
 sara: rolling back the shadow mirror config to 0% now. will retry after subnet fix and postmortem.
 raj: terraform change submitted, running `terraform plan` -> shows need to expand subnet_size var + update route table. ETA apply ~18m.
 lin h: typo in the previous message: pushing fix for helm values -> confirmed.
 deploy-bot: scheduled rollback of shadow release at 13:24 UTC :warning: (action: helm rollback model-rt-3-shadow 1)
 andrew: note for postmortem: add runbook step to validate subnet CIDR vs expected for any progressive delivery that increases pod density.
 sara: filing ticket INFRA-789 with cost impact estimate and runbook updates. pausing until terraform apply completes and we validate autoscaler behavior.
 raj: after apply, I'll run a small canary (2% mirror) and watch eviction/oom logs before ramping.
 mike: thanks — we should also add a pre-flight check in the CI pipeline that verifies available allocatable IPs and expected GPUs for shadow rollouts.
 sara: agreed. will schedule a short retro later today. :+1:
